name: PdfFile
label: PDF File Path
description: The path to the PDF file from which to extract tables.

name: PageSelection
label: Page Selection Mode
description: Select how to choose pages for table extraction: All, Single, or Range.

name: Password
label: Password
description: Optional password for encrypted PDF files. Leave empty if not required.

name: MergeTablesAcrossPages
label: Merge Tables Across Pages
description: If true, merges tables across pages into a single table. If false, creates separate tables for each page.

name: FirstLineAsHeaders
label: First Line Contains Column Names
description: If true, uses the first line of each page as column headers. If false, uses default column names.

name: PageNumber
label: Page Number (for Single)
description: The specific page number to extract tables from. Only used if Page Selection is set to Single.

name: FromPageNumber
label: From Page Number (for Range)
description: The starting page number for extracting tables in a range. Only used if Page Selection is set to Range.

name: ToPageNumber
label: To Page Number (for Range)
description: The ending page number for extracting tables in a range. Only used if Page Selection is set to Range.

name: ExtractedTables
label: Extracted Tables
description: The output list of DataTables extracted from the PDF.
